purpose: Close the revised-PEP artifact metadata audit by assigning an explicit evidence state to every volume instead of leaving generic pending values.

status_definitions.verified: Edition-matched ISBN/publication metadata is supported by sufficient independent evidence and the artifact matches the revised sequence.
status_definitions.single_source_candidate: A plausible edition-matched identifier appears in one current source but lacks an independent second match; it must not be rendered as verified ISBN.
status_definitions.not_publicly_recovered: The revised artifact/edition is verified, but no trustworthy edition-matched ISBN was recovered from publicly indexed sources by the research date.
status_definitions.designed_sequence_verified_artifact_not_: The revised series design is authoritative, but the corresponding later-semester classroom artifact is not required to be publicly available in the documented rollout phase as of the research date.
status_definitions.rollout_context_required: Actual classroom use depends on locality, approved publisher and term and cannot be represented as one nationwide state.

volumes.candidate_evidence: A current JD result labels the 2026 spring PEP Grade 2 lower textbook with ISBN 9787107389139.
volumes.render_rule: Do not display candidate ISBN as verified. The physical revised artifact and first-edition date may be displayed without ISBN.

publication_rules: Only status verified may display an ISBN without a qualification label.
single_source_candidate values remain internal research notes unless explicitly requested with their evidence status.
not_publicly_recovered is a completed research state, not a guessed null and not permission to substitute a legacy ISBN.
designed_sequence_verified_artifact_not_yet_required must not be rendered as a missing/error state.
Actual-use questions require locality + textbook publisher + term when known.
